correct_orders: Obtain a detailed history and perform a physical examination
Order X-rays to rule out fractures or other bony abnormalities
Consider ordering an MRI if symptoms persist or worsen, or in cases of severe trauma
If the diagnosis is still uncertain, consider a knee aspiration and synovial fluid analysis
should_avoid: Order immediate joint arthroscopy without proper diagnostics
